name: switch
summary: A labelled on/off setting that takes effect at once, with its label beside it.

properties.name: label
properties.description: The setting it turns on, beside the switch and its spoken name.

properties.name: hideLabel
properties.description: Hides the label's words; the switch keeps it as its name.

properties.name: description
properties.description: Supporting words under the label, read after the name.

properties.name: error
properties.description: What is wrong; the switch is invalid while it has one.

properties.name: required
properties.description: The switch must be on; the label gets a marker and the name says required.

events.name: change
events.description: The switch was turned on or off.

states.name: rest
states.description: Off: the muted track inside an edge at 3:1. On: the track filled in the primary colour, so on and off differ by fill and not only by hue.

states.name: pressed
states.description: The thumb stretches, never under reduced motion.

accessibility.name: Its label, with required when it is; its state on or off; then its error and description.
accessibility.keyboard: One tab stop; Space toggles it.
accessibility.web: A role="switch" button with aria-checked, named by its label, aria-describedby for the description and error.
accessibility.apple: One element with the toggle trait, named by its label (", required"), its value On or Off, its hint the error then the description.
accessibility.windows: UI Automation ControlType.Button with the Toggle pattern (On, Off), named by its label; WinUI's ToggleSwitch is the same pattern.
accessibility.android: Role.Switch with the toggleable state (On, Off) and a click action, named by its label (", required"); its error is the error semantics and its description is read after the state, which stays On or Off.

cases.person: A filled track with the thumb at its end, beside "Wi-Fi".
An off switch beside "Nightly backups" with a red marker and the line "At 2 a.m." under it.

deviations: readOnly, name and value for forms, and SwitchGroup.
